metrics.AP: sklearn average_precision_score, not trapezoidal PR area
metrics.budget: ceil(0.10 * validation rows) separately per fold
metrics.capture_denominator: all failed rows in the validation fold
metrics.ties: score descending then sample_id ascending; bounds and random-tie expectation also saved
metrics.dispersion: sample std (ddof=1), min/max across 3 dependent expanding folds, not a confidence interval
metrics.pooling: sum captured / sum failures over disjoint validation blocks; not a global top10% ranking

limitations: Training development evidence only, not independent validation
No new holdout result or production recommendation
Chronological date blocks do not establish lot/machine separation; those IDs are unavailable
Repeated historical training use and small failure counts limit generalization claims
